items.html:
(to the question) The nursing of the NHY from the breasts
After the coming of the Gadlut of nursing, that is, in the seven years following the second pregnancy, the GAR of Ruach are then clothed in the vessels of HBD, and the phase of the VAK of nursing descends to the HGT NHY, for the GAR of Ruach reject the Katnut downward. And it is then discerned that the phase of the milk of the nursing of the twenty-four months descended and was clothed in the NHY; and it is now found that the NHY of ZA nurse from the breasts of Ima, meaning that they receive these Mochin of the nursing of the twenty-four months.
